entries.147bd8d5764d3921: This is the business that manufactures and sells die-cast products (cast products made by pouring molten aluminum alloy into a mold under high pressure), mainly for automobiles, and it is the core of the group. The main products are die-cast products mainly for automobiles, mold-cast products and dies for die casting. It supplies products to customers through product design (including analysis of molten metal flow and strength), die manufacturing, prototyping and mass production (die casting, machining and so on), and almost all group companies take part in some stage of this series of processes. The annual securities report divides the reportable segments into 3 regions, because this business is developed with strategies set for each of Japan, North America and Asia. It states that since 9 tenths or more of the die-casting business's operating revenue comes from automobile-related business, its results are strongly affected by automobile production volumes in Japan and overseas.

The annual securities report states that operating profit and net income increased due to the effects of structural reforms, including the appropriate scaling of headcount implemented in the previous year, and the recovery in order volumes, and that the company returned to profit for the current period for the first time in seven periods. Ordinary profit decreased from the previous year due to a decrease in non-operating income and an increase in non-operating expenses. Meanwhile, the North American segment continued to record a loss, and the company has made improving the profitability of its U.S. plant its top priority. The annual securities report states that, due to soaring raw material and energy prices stemming from the situation in the Middle East, results for the next period are expected to fall below those of the current period.

entries.a676017bdad3b9cf: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the group (the company and 13 subsidiaries) engages in 3 businesses: the die casting business, the aluminum business, and the finished products business. At its center is the die casting business, which makes parts by pouring molten aluminum alloy into molds; at plants in Japan, North America (the United States and Mexico) and Asia (China and India), it manufactures and sells die casting products, mainly for automobiles. It is stated that more than 9-tenths of the die casting business's operating revenue is automotive-related. In addition, there are the aluminum business, which manufactures and sells aluminum alloy ingots, and the finished products business, which installs and sells raised access floors for construction. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥167,092 million.
